ontology.note: Existing ontology alignment; full configuration and port shape contracts remain to be defined.

changes.description: A boundary acquired below ADM0 can carry its country outline, for context: a province drawn with nothing around it is hard to place. Read from the same geoBoundaries release as the units and as the simplified geometry, 339 KB for DR Congo against 2.4 MB, with its own licence rather than the unit's. It is drawn under everything as a line with no fill, and nothing clips, counts or joins to it.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. 0.8.0: tests/area-countries.test.mjs (4: the list read from a saved country; Gaborone to the border proposes Botswana and South Africa and the interior Botswana alone; half each on a square split by a straight border; the national outline's URL) and tests/area-countries.browser.mjs (found with shares, confirmed, applied; named by hand; a saved country as a list of one). Not checked by somebody else's code. 0.9.1: tests/study-area.test.mjs (an enclave starting on its hole's east edge is accepted, and refused without the hole; fails on 0.9.0's check) and tests/mers-from-scratch.browser.mjs (South Korea's 17 provinces as a study area); Chromium. 0.9.2: tests/boundary-source.test.mjs (South Korea, north korea, Vietnam resolve; Korea alone does not; the other names are all Natural Earth's where they differ). 0.9.3: tests/study-area.test.mjs (a district with a 1 m² part accepted and kept; 1 m² alone refused); Rwanda's 30 districts applied in tests/population-models-from-scratch.browser.mjs; Chromium. 0.9.4: tests/study-area.test.mjs (two holes meeting at a corner on the other's edge admitted, which 0.9.3 refused with Rwanda's message; a hole inside a hole still refused). 0.13.0: tests/country-outline-acquire.browser.mjs with geoBoundaries stubbed, and tests/country-outline.browser.mjs for the drawing; Chromium, 2026-11-23.
